description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that provides static methods to facilitate logging within an Android application. It acts as a wrapper and utility for Android's native logging system, 'android.util.Log,' and manages a chain of log nodes for custom log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods to log messages at various levels and manage the presence of a LogNode chain for custom log handling.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to route log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, with or without a Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, with or without a Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, with or without a Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, optionally with a Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, optionally with a Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, optionally with a Throwable.
